title: Customers and Vendors counts are right aligned and show 0 when none
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has just made a new term that no customer or vendor uses yet, while Net 30 is in use.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, is held by no customer and no vendor (it is new).
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-19 Empty.
  • At least one customer holds Net 30.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Look at the Customers and Vendors cells of the {Term-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both cells read "0" (not blank, not a dash), right aligned in their columns. The count is right aligned, its last digit lined up with the 0 of the {Term-A} row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R12: “The Customers column shows how many customers hold the term, right aligned, showing 0 when none. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer with a blank term is counted under COD. Names that differ only in capitals and spaces count toward the same term ("NET 30" counts as Net 30; see §6).”
  • S1-R13: “The Vendors column shows how many vendors hold the term, right aligned, 0 when none, by the same rules as S1-R12 (a blank vendor term counts under COD).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Active tab: one table"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

  • “The Customers and Vendors columns show how many customers and vendors are on each term (0 shown as 0). The Customers count never includes the Counter Sale customer.”
